title: Romanian Revolution, 1989
author: Modern
content:
Heroes' Cemetery 
Timisoara - Romania
 28K 

 This is a picture from Timisoara's Heroes Cemetery, where most

 of the victims of the 1998 Coup d'Etat are buried. 

   1104 people died in December 1989. Before December 22nd 162 people 
   died, 73 in Timisoara, 48 in Bucharest and 41 somewhere else in
   Romania. 3352 people were wounded. Some of the first victims were
   sent to Bucharest and cremated. The military had 260 dead, and 545
   wounded. The "Securitatea" 65 dead and 73 wounded. 

 After the arrest on December 22nd, Nicolae and Elena CEAUSESCU were held
at "Garnizoana Targoviste" (UM* 01378 and UM01476). During the day they were guarded inside the military base
and at night inside an APC**.

 

Picture number one and two: Nicolae CEAUSESCU getting out of the APC, just before the "trial" both
Elena and Nicolae are seen by a military MD. Just a PR, they all knew that they will be executed
in a few hours.

 

Two video clips, from the "trial". THEY made sure that nobody else in that room was in the video.
They were in a big hurry, ILIESCU and his clan, didn't want to take any chances. 

* UM - Military base

** APC - Armored Personnel Carrier
